memory_candidates.content: When a registration/index file itself has the hand-maintained mixed-compaction shape a new 'avoid whole-file jq rewrites' guidance describes, apply that same guidance's own recipe to the edit of the registration file, rather than treating the registration update as exempt. Recipe: take HEAD bytes (git show HEAD:path), apply the intended field changes as a text-level edit on a copy, independently compute the intended result with jq from the same HEAD bytes, assert canonicalized equality (diff <(jq -S . text-edited) <(jq -S . jq-output) must be empty), then move the text-edited copy into place. The equality assertion is load-bearing: it buys back jq's well-formedness guarantee that a bare text edit gives up.
